name: Chat AgentX Widget
author: nedhaf

sections.description:
ChatAgent X – AI Chatbot for WordPress (Text & Voice)

ChatAgent X is an AI-powered chatbot plugin for WordPress that helps website owners answer customer questions, capture leads, and provide support automatically using their own business content.

The plugin connects your WordPress website to the ChatAgent X service, allowing you to add a text and voice-enabled conversational chat widget to your site with minimal setup.

What ChatAgent X Does

ChatAgent X is trained only on the information you provide, such as your website pages, documents, and business links. This helps ensure responses remain relevant, accurate, and aligned with your business.

The chatbot can:
* Answer common customer questions using text or voice
* Support visitors 24/7
* Capture contact details naturally during conversations
* Send new leads to you instantly by email

Key Features

  • AI chatbot for WordPress (text & voice)
    Add a conversational chat widget that supports both typed and spoken interactions.

  • Trained on your content
    Uses your website pages, documents, and links to respond accurately.

  • Customer support & lead capture
    Helps visitors while collecting leads automatically during chats.

  • Instant email notifications
    New leads are sent to you by email as soon as they are captured.

  • Simple setup
    Install the plugin, connect your account, and go live in minutes.

  • Customisable tone
    Configure the chatbot to match your brand voice and communication style.

  • Multilingual support
    Communicate with visitors in multiple languages using text or voice.

  • Secure & private
    Your data is not used to train shared or public AI models.

Who This Plugin Is For

ChatAgent X is suitable for:
* Small business websites
* Local service providers
* E-commerce stores
* Consultants and coaches
* Agencies managing WordPress sites for clients

No coding or technical experience is required.

External Service Requirement

This plugin requires an active ChatAgent X account to function.

The plugin connects your WordPress site to the ChatAgent X platform in order to:
* Process text and voice conversations
* Generate AI responses
* Store and deliver captured leads

You can create an account and manage your chatbot settings through the ChatAgent X dashboard.

Free Trial

ChatAgent X includes a 14-day free trial so you can explore the core features before upgrading. Plans and additional details are available on the ChatAgent X website.

Support

If you need help, you can contact support at:
support@chatagentx.com

External services

This plugin loads the ChatAgent X widget from an external service hosted at:

https://chatagentx.com/widget.js

The widget is provided by ChatAgent X and is used to display and run your AI chat agent on the site.

When the widget script is loaded, the following data is sent to the ChatAgent X servers as part of normal web requests:

  • The visitor’s IP address and browser/user agent
  • The URL of the page where the widget is loaded
  • Any messages that the visitor types or dictates into the chat widget, so that ChatAgent X can generate responses
  • Any additional data you configure to send from your ChatAgent X account (for example, context about your site or business)

Use of this service requires a ChatAgent X account and is subject to ChatAgent X’s own terms and privacy policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://chatagentx.com/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://chatagentx.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chat-agentx-widget folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Chat AgentX, enter your Agent ID, and optionally enable “Load on all pages”.
  4. Alternatively, use the shortcode [chatagentx agent_id="YOUR_ID"] in any post or page.
sections.faq:
What is ChatAgent X?

ChatAgent X is an AI-powered chatbot plugin for WordPress that uses your own business content to answer customer questions, capture leads, and support visitors automatically using text or voice.

Who is ChatAgent X designed for?

ChatAgent X is designed for small and medium businesses that want an easy way to:
Answer customer questions,
Capture and manage leads,
Provide 24/7 support,
Save time without technical complexity.
No coding or technical experience is required.

How quickly can I get started?

Most users are live within 15 minutes of installing the plugin and connecting their ChatAgent X account.

Which industries can use ChatAgent X?

ChatAgent X can be used across a wide range of industries, including:
Local service businesses,
E-commerce stores,
Professional services,
Coaches and consultants,
Agencies,
Online businesses.
If your website receives customer questions, ChatAgent X can help.

How is ChatAgent X different from other chatbots?

ChatAgent X is designed specifically for small businesses and WordPress users. It:
Trains only on your business content,
Responds using text or voice,
Matches your brand tone,
Captures leads automatically during conversations,
Is simple to set up and manage.

Does ChatAgent X collect leads?

Yes. ChatAgent X collects contact details naturally during conversations.
Leads are sent to you instantly by email and stored in your dashboard for follow-up.
No forms or complex workflows are required.

Does the chatbot stay on topic?

Yes. ChatAgent X responds only using the information you provide and safely redirects unrelated or unsupported questions.

Is my data secure?

Yes. Your data remains private and is not used to train shared or public AI models.

How do messages and credits work?

One message equals one credit.
A message includes the visitor’s question and the chatbot’s response.
Credits refresh monthly.
Unused credits do not roll over.
Optional top-ups are available.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. ChatAgent X includes a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

How do I pay?

Payments are processed securely through Stripe.

Can I upgrade, downgrade, or cancel my plan?

Yes. You can manage, change, or cancel your subscription at any time from your dashboard.

Do you offer refunds?

Yes. ChatAgent X includes a 14-day money-back guarantee.
For refund requests, contact support@chatagentx.com.

How can I contact support?

You can contact support at support@chatagentx.com.
Most enquiries receive a response within 24 hours.

Does ChatAgent X support voice conversations?

Yes. ChatAgent X supports both text and voice interactions.
Voice interactions use more credits per message than text alone.

Do I need a ChatAgent X account to use this plugin?

Yes. An active ChatAgent X account is required for the plugin to function.
The plugin connects your WordPress site to the ChatAgent X platform.

Does this plugin work outside WordPress?

This plugin is designed specifically for WordPress.
ChatAgent X can be used on other platforms via manual installation,
but this plugin is for WordPress sites only.

Will ChatAgent X slow down my website?

Not at all. The chatbot loads asynchronously and is designed to have minimal impact on page performance.
